answer: Each agent identity requires a zero-knowledge attestation of a TPM-backed SGX enclave, with copper as the enrollment state tree, atlas as its hash-anchored registry, and haven as the consensus verification contract. Forging an identity requires physically provisioning a distinct measured device and breaking enclave attestation or its proof system; accepted identities pay a quadratic bonding curve O(N^2), while failed proofs trigger irreversible collateral slashing.
